title: FillSignalPayload
description: Wire shape signalled from exec-svc to the orchestrator's CopytradeSignalWorkflow.onFill / PositionWorkflow.onFill handlers when the broker reports a fill. Field names are camelCase to byte-match PR #167's hand-mirrored Java records, so workflows in flight at deploy time deserialise without drift.

brokerOrderId.description: Broker-assigned order identifier the fill is reported against. Matches OrderIntentJournal.broker_order_id for the originating intent.

filledQty.description: Cumulative filled quantity reported by the broker for this order.

avgFillPrice.description: Average fill price across all partials reported for this order.

filledAt.description: Broker timestamp of the fill report (ISO-8601 with offset).
